name: Meeting Statistics

native.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.meeting_bookings WHERE start_time >= date_trunc('week', NOW()) AND status IN ('SCHEDULED', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'COMPLETED')

SELECT r.name, COUNT(b.id) as booking_count FROM {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.meeting_bookings b JOIN {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.meeting_rooms r ON r.id = b.room_id WHERE b.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY booking_count DESC
SELECT status, COUNT(*) as count FROM {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.meeting_action_items GROUP BY status
